description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingCommandResponse' that models responses related to 'ThingCommand' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes constants, method signatures, default method implementations, and an inner static class for JSON field definitions, indicating its role as part of the response messaging framework for commands on 'things'.

classes.name: ThingCommandResponse
classes.description: A Java interface representing responses to 'ThingCommand' operations, parameterized with a self-referential type, extending command response and 'WithThingId'.

classes.name: ThingCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Inner static class defining JSON field constants relevant to 'ThingCommandResponse' JSON representation, specifically the 'thingId' field.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Default method returning the 'ThingId' associated with the response, obtained via 'getThingEntityId()'.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Default method returning the resource type string associated with 'ThingCommand'.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Inherited method (assumed from 'WithThingId') to retrieve the associated 'ThingId'.
